stories.title: Looking for the Formula to Stop an Apocalypse
stories.summary: Mike Winer and his team are working to develop a mathematical system to ensure artificial intelligence remains under human supervision. They are concerned about the urgency of their task.

stories.title: Nvidia chip case: How Chinese man in Megaspeed built network serving China with Alice Huang
stories.summary: A Chinese individual reportedly established a network to supply China with Nvidia chips, according to information involving Alice Huang.

stories.title: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
stories.summary: An employee at Anthropic reportedly solved a significant mathematical problem with assistance from artificial intelligence.

stories.title: AI-generated videos, photos alone don’t amount to forgery: HC
stories.summary: The High Court has stated that AI-generated videos and photos by themselves do not constitute forgery.

stories.title: Apple iPhone 18 Leaks: Expected Price In India, Specifications And Features
stories.summary: The Apple iPhone 18 is anticipated to launch in March 2027. It is expected to feature an A20 2nm chip, a 120Hz OLED display, 48MP dual cameras, and iOS 27.

stories.title: The Claude payday: How Anthropic’s IPO could make thousands of staff millionaires
stories.summary: The headline reports on how Anthropic's potential IPO could lead to many employees becoming millionaires.

stories.title: India, EU To Sign Long-Awaited FTA On December 16: Report
stories.summary: India and the EU are reportedly set to sign a long-awaited Free Trade Agreement on December 16. This agreement, which has been under negotiation for over two decades, is expected to create a significant market of approximately 2 billion people.

stories.title: Lending To Small Businesses Can Deliver Greater Economic Benefits Than Big Corporate Loans: RBI Governor
stories.summary: The RBI Governor stated that providing loans to small businesses can yield greater economic advantages compared to large corporate loans. He added that distributing the same amount among micro-enterprise borrowers could amplify these benefits significantly.

stories.title: Procter & Gamble to Increase Factory Shifts Without Humans to Cut Costs
stories.summary: Procter & Gamble plans to increase the number of factory shifts that operate without human supervision to reduce costs. The company, which produces Pampers and Bounty, currently has 15 such sites and intends to expand this number by 2027.

stories.title: Crude Shock: India's Oil And Gas Import Bill Jumps 60% In October
stories.summary: India's oil and gas import bill saw a 60% increase in October. This rise is attributed to the average price of crude oil, with Brent averaging $116.77 in September and $64.75 in October 2025, and the Indian basket averaging $119.91 in October compared to $65.08 a year prior.

stories.title: Israeli settlers launch attacks across West Bank as Netanyahu rival decries “Jewish terrorism”
stories.summary: Israeli settlers have reportedly launched attacks across the West Bank. This comes as a political figure in Israel has spoken out against what they termed "Jewish terrorism."

stories.title: Republicans Debate Why They Lost the Midterms, and if Trump Is to Blame
stories.summary: Republicans are discussing the reasons behind their losses in the recent midterm elections. A key point of contention within the party is whether former President Trump is responsible for these outcomes, indicating a future struggle over the party's direction.

stories.title: Deadly Protests Erupt in Bangladesh Over Exiled Former Leader. What to Know.
stories.summary: Deadly protests have broken out in Bangladesh following the sentencing of former prime minister Sheikh Hasina. Her supporters are engaging in an insurgency to destabilize the current government.

stories.title: 'Working to suppress India’s rise': US panel report flags China's support to Pakistan during Operation Si
stories.summary: A US panel report indicates that China provided support to Pakistan during Operation Si, suggesting an effort to hinder India's growth.

stories.title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Arrives in Delhi On First State Visit, To Meet PM Modi on Monday
stories.summary: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah has arrived in Delhi for his first state visit. He is scheduled to meet with Prime Minister Modi on Monday.

stories.title: US tightens regulations for international students: Work permit fees could reach $70,000.
stories.summary: The United States is implementing stricter rules for international students, which could lead to work permit fees increasing significantly, potentially up to $70,000. This change may impact the ability of international students to work in the U.S. after their studies.

stories.title: US H-1B Crisis Worsens: NRIs Abandon American Tech Jobs
stories.summary: The situation regarding H-1B visas in the U.S. is reportedly deteriorating, causing non-resident Indians (NRIs) to leave American technology jobs. This suggests a growing challenge for foreign workers in the U.S. tech sector.

stories.title: I'm a business immigration lawyer. Trump's visa policies are making my clients pause their lives.
stories.summary: A business immigration lawyer reports that current visa policies are causing clients to put their lives on hold. This indicates that the policies are creating significant disruptions for individuals seeking to immigrate for business purposes.

stories.title: H-1B visa curbs could hurt US workers in non-STEM jobs, study says | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: A study suggests that restrictions on H-1B visas might negatively affect U.S. workers in fields outside of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. This indicates that the impact of these visa policies could extend beyond the STEM sector.

stories.title: Immigration officers make arrests at Seattle airport in ‘distressing’ scene, delaying flight
stories.summary: Immigration officers conducted arrests at Seattle airport, which reportedly caused a distressing scene and delayed a flight. This event highlights the impact of immigration enforcement activities on airport operations and travelers.
